text: HackerTube 是面向 DSH Web 面板的技术视频浏览插件，将 Hacker News 长期推荐的视频库接入侧栏与主面板。用户可按类别浏览并用中英文搜索标题、频道、标签和分类，也能通过对话工具检索视频。适合寻找技术演讲、课程和访谈的开发者；面板展示视频详情与 HN 讨论。插件从 HackerTube、YouTube 等服务获取数据，中文翻译使用 Google 翻译服务；不要求用户另配 API Key。

HackerTube brings Hacker News technical videos to DSH. Browse categories, search in Chinese or English, and open video details and discussions. Agents can search the library too. It uses HackerTube, YouTube, and Google Translate; no user API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里按主题找技术演讲和课程。
帮我搜索 Hacker News 推荐过的编程或计算机科学视频。
Find technical talks and courses by topic inside my DSH panel.
HackerTube 的功能「分类浏览与搜索」：在 DSH 面板按分类浏览技术视频，也可用中文或英文搜索标题、频道、标签和分类。输入搜索词或选择分类后，面板显示匹配的视频卡片。
HackerTube 的功能「对话检索」：注册 hackertube_search 工具，供 agent 按中英文关键词搜索视频库。调用时提供 query，可选返回数量与语言，结果包含视频标题、频道和链接等信息。
HackerTube 会向上游获取视频数据，并向 Google 翻译服务请求机翻；使用翻译功能时，相关文本会发送给该服务。

dsh-hackertube README · HackerTube for DeepSeek Harness：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

在 DSH 面板内浏览并播放 Hacker News 二十年间反复推荐的技术视频，无需切换到浏览器。触手可及的高质量英文视频信源，让你的 DeepSeek Harness 变得更丰富有趣。

数据集来自 Andrej Karpathy 的 [HackerTube](https://karpathy.bearblog.dev/hacker-tube/)。站点提供完整的数据导出，作者在博客中说明其用途：

> Export of the site's data available to give to your agent to easily create your own version.

本插件使用的正是这份官方导出。非官方项目，与 Andrej Karpathy、Hacker News、YouTube 均无隶属关系。

原站同样可以直接访问。将其并入面板带来两点差异：一是省去窗口切换，二是提供完整的中文支持，包括标题、分类、摘要与评论。

dsh-hackertube README · 功能：收录 6454 个视频，分属 16 个大类与 150 个二级分类，按 HN 推荐力度排序。首页首次加载 60 条，滚动时分批追加。

详情页包含播放器、该视频在 HN 上的讨论，以及右侧的相关推荐。右侧另有 AI 问答页，会把当前播放位置前后三分钟的字幕片段一并交给模型，因此可以询问某一段的具体内容。

搜索支持中英文混用，中文查询会同时匹配中文标题与英文标签。

喜欢、稍后看与播放历史记录在宿主侧，清除浏览器数据不会丢失。

dsh-hackertube README · 快捷键：| 按键 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/` | 聚焦搜索框 |
| `j` `k` | 在卡片间上下移动 |
| `Enter` | 打开当前卡片 |
| `l` | 标记喜欢 |
| `w` | 加入稍后看 |
| `h` | 返回首页 |
| `?` | 显示快捷键一览 |
| `Esc` | 关闭浮层 |
dsh-hackertube README · 给 agent 用的工具：插件注册了一个工具 `hackertube_search`。装了插件之后，不用打开面板，agent 在对话里就能检索这个视频库。

dsh-hackertube README · 一次完整的对话：你问：

> 有没有讲 Raft 共识算法的视频？最好是作者本人讲的。

agent 调用 `hackertube_search({ query: "Raft 共识算法", limit: 5 })`，工具返回（节选）：

```
1. Paxos 讲座（Raft 用户研究） — Diego Ongaro · 67 分钟 · 11.4 万次观看 · 6 人推荐
   HN：Recommended as a clear, lucid way to learn Paxos and Multi-Paxos…
   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEpsBg0AO6o

agent 据此回答：

> 有，而且就是 Raft 作者 Diego Ongaro 本人讲的。先看第二个《Raft 讲座》，58 分钟，HN 上的评论说它比读论文好懂；它和第一个《Paxos 讲座》是同一套课程，通常一起看。
> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YbZ3zDzDnrw

dsh-hackertube README · 适合这类请求：- 有没有讲 Raft 共识算法的视频
- 找几个讲编译器优化的演讲
- Karpathy 讲反向传播的是哪一个

dsh-hackertube README · 它做什么：按中英文检索标题、频道、标签、分类，以及每个视频的简介和 HN 推荐理由，返回标题、频道、时长、观看量、HN 推荐人数、推荐理由与链接，并按 HN 推荐强度排序。中文查询也能命中，结果里的标题会显示中文译文。

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `query` | 检索词，中英文均可 |
| `limit` | 返回条数，默认 5，最多 15 |
| `lang` | 返回文案的语言，`zh` 或 `en`，默认 `zh` |

dsh-hackertube README · 首次启动：插件加载时即开始下载官方数据导出（17.8 MB，一次性），并同时请求上游接口补齐 YouTube 的时长、播放量与发布时间。两者完成后列表才是完整状态，期间界面显示骨架屏。

| 项目 | 实测耗时 |
|---|---|
| 首次安装（空缓存） | 约 10 秒 |
| 后续启动，列表加载 | 45 毫秒 |
| 打开详情页 | 10 毫秒 |
| 相关推荐，有共推荐关系的 3778 个视频 | 2 毫秒 |
| 相关推荐，其余 2676 个视频（向量近邻） | 首次约 0.7 秒 |
| 摘要与推荐理由机翻 | 首次 0.4 至 1.8 秒 |

数据导出有效期为七天，YouTube 元信息缓存二十四小时。

dsh-hackertube README · 中文支持：界面文案统一通过 `tx(lang, 中文, English)` 输出，两种语言下均不会出现中英混排。数量单位随语言切换，中文使用万与亿，英文使用 K 与 M。

内容层面的中文来源如下。

| 内容 | 来源 | 生效时机 |
|---|---|---|
| 6454 条视频标题 | 随仓库附带的译文表 | 安装后立即生效 |
| 166 条分类名称 | 随仓库附带 | 安装后立即生效 |
| 摘要、推荐理由、评论引用 | 打开时自动翻译 | 优先使用模型，模型不可用时使用机翻 |
| HN 评论正文 | 逐条翻译或整段翻译 | 首次约 1 秒，之后读取缓存 |

模型译文与机翻译文分别存放。配置模型后，模型译文会覆盖机翻结果，不会因机翻先行而无法更新。

机翻调用 Google 网页翻译的公共端点。评论正文默认保持英文原文，翻译为显式操作。

dsh-hackertube README · 依赖与降级：| 能力 | 依赖 | 缺失时的表现 |
|---|---|---|
| 列表、分类、搜索、播放 | DSH 的 webServer 与外网 | 面板不可用或播放器无法加载 |
| 中文标题与分类名 | 无 | 已随仓库提供 |
| 摘要等三段文本的中文 | 模型或外网 | 显示英文原文 |
| AI 问答 | DSH 已配置模型 | 面板提示模型不可用，其余功能正常 |
| 评论翻译 | 外网 | 按钮无响应，文本保持原文 |
| 字幕与直链兜底播放 | PATH 中存在 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg | 视频仍可播放，AI 缺少字幕上下文 |

yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg 均为可选。它们只影响两件事：AI 问答能否携带字幕上下文，以及 YouTube 嵌入被拒绝时能否回退到直链播放。

dsh-hackertube README · 数据来源：`https://hackertube.org/download/hackertube-data.zip`，17.8 MB，导出于 2026 年 10 月 31 日。

```
videos.jsonl       6454 条视频，含标题、频道、摘要、推荐理由、标签、分类、HN 统计
mentions.jsonl    39834 条 HN 评论，含作者、月份、立场、原文
related.jsonl      3778 条共推荐关系
embeddings.npy     6454 × 384 维 float16 向量，用于补齐无共推荐关系的视频

解压使用 Node 内置的 zlib，插件不引入任何 npm 运行时依赖。

导出不包含时长、播放量、发布时间与封面，这些字段属于 YouTube 元数据，因此列表仍会并行请求 65 页上游接口补齐，结果缓存一天。

dsh-hackertube README · 缓存目录：全部位于 `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.dsh-hackertube/`，默认路径为 `~/.dsh/.dsh-hackertube/`。删除整个目录可恢复到初始状态。

```
export/               解包后的官方数据，约 48 MB
i18n/zh-titles.json   标题译文
i18n/zh-taxonomy.json 分类译文
i18n/zh.json          模型翻译的详情文本

dsh-hackertube README · 已知限制：标题译文由模型生成后按规则校对，多数通顺，仍有约一千条偏向直译。

中文查询需要先机翻为英文才能命中英文标签，每次查询发起一次请求，含 300 毫秒防抖与内存缓存。断网时仅保留本地匹配。

YouTube 嵌入受上游策略限制，年龄限制或地区限制的视频需前往 YouTube 观看。

播放中转页监听 `127.0.0.1:18090`，端口被占用时依次尝试 18091 与 18092。

dsh-hackertube README · 致谢：感谢 Andrej Karpathy 开发 HackerTube 并将数据导出公开，本插件建立在这份工作之上。

讨论内容来自 [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com)，视频托管于 YouTube。

dsh-hackertube README · HackerTube for DeepSeek Harness：[简体中文](README.md) | English

Browse and watch the videos Hacker News has recommended over two decades, without leaving the DeepSeek Harness panel. A high-quality English video library within reach, which makes the harness a richer and more enjoyable place to work.

The dataset comes from [HackerTube](https://karpathy.bearblog.dev/hacker-tube/) by Andrej Karpathy. The site ships a complete data export, and the author describes its purpose in his post:

dsh-hackertube README · HackerTube for DeepSeek Harness：> Export of the site's data available to give to your agent to easily create your own version.

This plugin consumes that official export. It is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with Andrej Karpathy, Hacker News, or YouTube.

The original site works fine on its own. Moving it into the panel changes two things. You no longer switch windows, and the interface is fully available in Chinese, including titles, categories, summaries, and comments.

dsh-hackertube README · Let your agent install it：Paste this into a DeepSeek Harness session. The agent installs the plugin, enables it, and checks the result:

```
Install and enable the HackerTube plugin: plugin_manager install_bundle target=dsh-hackertube.
If npm fails, use target=github:chow651/dsh-hackertube instead.
Then confirm dsh-hackertube is enabled in the plugin list and remind me to refresh the page.
```

dsh-hackertube README · Install with the plugin manager：The package is published on npm:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=dsh-hackertube
```

It can also be installed straight from the Git repository, though how the host parses the install argument depends on its version:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=github:chow651/dsh-hackertube
```

dsh-hackertube README · Install with npm or pnpm：```
npm install dsh-hackertube
```

```
pnpm add dsh-hackertube
```

DSH loads plugins from its profile directory, so installing into an ordinary project has no effect. Install inside that profile directory, add the package name to its `dsh.profile.bundles` array, then restart DSH. The `plugin_manager` command above does all three steps for you. Take the manual route only for scripting or bulk deployment.
dsh-hackertube README · Install with npm or pnpm：After installing, enable `dsh-hackertube` in the plugin list and refresh the page. No configuration, no API key, and no data to fetch beforehand.

dsh-hackertube README · Features：The panel holds 6,454 videos across 16 areas and 150 categories, ordered by how strongly Hacker News recommends them. The home grid loads 60 cards at first and appends more as you scroll.

The watch page has the player, the Hacker News discussion for that video, and a related rail on the right. The rail has a second pane for AI questions. It hands the model the subtitle lines within three minutes of the current playhead, so you can ask what a particular segment covers.

dsh-hackertube README · Features：Search works with English and Chinese queries. A Chinese query matches both the Chinese title and the English tags.

Likes, watch later, and history live on the host side, so clearing browser data does not lose them.

|---|---|
| `/` | Focus the search field |
| `j` `k` | Move between cards |
| `Enter` | Open the focused card |
| `l` | Like |
| `w` | Add to watch later |
| `h` | Back to home |
| `?` | Show all shortcuts |
| `Esc` | Close overlay |

dsh-hackertube README · A tool for your agent：The plugin registers a tool named `hackertube_search`. Once installed, your agent can search this video library from any conversation, without opening the panel.

dsh-hackertube README · One full exchange：You ask:

> Which video should I actually watch to understand backpropagation?

The agent calls `hackertube_search({ query: "backpropagation", limit: 5, lang: "en" })`, and the tool returns (excerpt):

```
1. The spelled-out intro to neural networks and backpropagation: building micrograd — Andrej Karpathy · 146 min · 4.4M views · 17 recommenders
   HN: HN treats it as the best starting point for really understanding backprop and neural nets…
   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMj-3S1tku0

dsh-hackertube README · One full exchange：The agent answers:

> Start with Karpathy's "building micrograd", 146 min. It has 17 recommenders, the strongest signal HN gives, and it builds backpropagation from scratch in code instead of explaining it on paper. If you want the intuition first, watch the 3Blue1Brown chapter (13 min) before it.
> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMj-3S1tku0

dsh-hackertube README · Good requests for it：- Any talk explaining Raft consensus
- A few lectures on compiler optimization
- Which Karpathy video covers backpropagation

dsh-hackertube README · What it does：Searches titles, channels, tags and categories in English and Chinese, plus each video's summary and Hacker News recommendation note. Results carry title, channel, duration, view count, recommender count, the recommendation note and a link, ordered by how strongly Hacker News recommends them. Chinese queries work, and titles come back in Chinese when a translation exists.

dsh-hackertube README · What it does：| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `query` | Search terms, English or Chinese |
| `limit` | Result count, default 5, max 15 |
| `lang` | Language for the returned text, `zh` or `en`, default `zh` |

dsh-hackertube README · First launch：The plugin starts downloading the official export as soon as it loads, 17.8 MB in one request, and at the same time requests upstream pages to fill in YouTube duration, view count, and publish date. The list is only complete once both finish. A skeleton screen covers the panel in the meantime.

dsh-hackertube README · First launch：| Scenario | Measured |
|---|---|
| First install, empty cache | about 10 seconds |
| Later launches, list load | 45 ms |
| Opening a watch page | 10 ms |
| Related, the 3,778 videos with co-recommendation data | 2 ms |
| Related, the other 2,676 videos, by vector similarity | about 0.7 s on first use |
| Machine translation of summary and recommendation note | 0.4 to 1.8 s on first use |

The export stays valid for seven days. YouTube metadata is cached for twenty-four hours.

dsh-hackertube README · Chinese support：Every interface string goes through `tx(lang, 中文, English)`, so neither language mode shows mixed text. Number units follow the language, with 万 and 亿 in Chinese and K and M in English.

Content-level Chinese comes from four places.

dsh-hackertube README · Chinese support：| Content | Source | When it applies |
|---|---|---|
| 6,454 video titles | Translation table shipped in the repository | Immediately after install |
| 166 category names | Shipped in the repository | Immediately after install |
| Summary, recommendation note, quoted comment | Translated when the page opens | Model first, machine translation as fallback |
| Hacker News comment bodies | Per comment or in bulk, on demand | About 1 second, then cached |

dsh-hackertube README · Chinese support：Model output and machine translation are stored separately. Once a model is configured, its translations replace the machine output rather than being blocked by it.

Machine translation uses the public Google web translate endpoint. Comment bodies stay in English by default. Translation is an explicit action.

dsh-hackertube README · Dependencies and degradation：| Capability | Requires | Without it |
|---|---|---|
| List, categories, search, playback | The DSH web server and network access | The panel or the player does not load |
| Chinese titles and category names | Nothing | Shipped with the repository |
| Chinese for summary and the other two fields | A model or network access | English source text is shown |
| AI questions | A model configured in DSH | The panel reports the model is unavailable, everything else works |
| Comment translation | Network access | The button does nothing and the text stays as written |
| Subtitles and direct-stream fallback | `yt-dlp` and `ffmpeg` on PATH | Video still plays, the AI answers lose subtitle context |

dsh-hackertube README · Dependencies and degradation：Both `yt-dlp` and `ffmpeg` are optional. They affect two things only, whether AI answers can use subtitles and whether playback can fall back to a direct stream when YouTube refuses the embed.

mentions.jsonl    39,834 HN comments with author, month, stance, and body
related.jsonl      3,778 co-recommendation rows

dsh-hackertube README · Data source：Unpacking uses the zlib module built into Node, so the plugin ships with no npm runtime dependencies.

The export has no duration, view count, publish date, or thumbnail, since those are YouTube metadata. The list therefore still requests 65 upstream pages in parallel to fill them in, cached for one day.

dsh-hackertube README · Cache：Everything lives under `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.dsh-hackertube/`, by default `~/.dsh/.dsh-hackertube/`. Deleting the directory resets the plugin to a clean state.

dsh-hackertube README · Known limitations：Title translations are model output checked by rules. Most read naturally, and roughly a thousand remain close to word-for-word.

A Chinese query is machine translated into English before it can reach English tags. That costs one request per query, debounced by 300 ms and cached in memory. Offline, only local matching applies.

YouTube embeds follow upstream policy. Age-restricted and region-restricted videos are only available on YouTube.
dsh-hackertube README · Known limitations：The playback relay listens on `127.0.0.1:18090`, falling back to 18091 and 18092 when the port is taken.
